source.author: verg
source.text: Obstipuit primo aspectu Sidonia Dido, casu deinde viri tanto, et sic ore locuta est:
source.text_original: Obstipuit primo aspectu Sidonia Dido, / casu deinde viri tanto, et sic ore locuta est: /
source.text_english: At the first sight Sidonian Dido was stunned, then at the great plight of the man, and thus she spoke with her face:

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text_english: She spoke thus with her mouth...
